PT VALE INDONESIA TBK

DAN ENTITAS ANAKNYA/
AND ITS SUBSIDIARY

LAPORAN KEUANGAN KONSOLIDASIAN INTERIM/
INTERIM CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS


31 MARET 2024 DAN 31 DESEMBER 2023,
DAN UNTUK PERIODE TIGA BULAN YANG BERAKHIR
31 MARET 2024 DAN 2023/
MARCH 31, 2024 AND DECEMBER 31, 2023,
AND FOR THE THREE-MONTH PERIODS ENDED
MARCH 31, 2024 AND 2023

LAPORAN AUDITOR INDEPENDEN             INDEPENDENT AUDITORS’ REPORT
     KEPADA PARA PEMEGANG SAHAM              TO THE SHAREHOLDERS OF

                         PT VALE INDONESIA TBK


Opini                                          Opinion

Kami telah mengaudit laporan keuangan         We have audited the interim consolidated financial
konsolidasian interim PT Vale Indonesia Tbk dan       statements of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk and its
entitas anaknya (“Grup”), yang terdiri dari laporan       subsidiary (the “Group”), which comprise the interim
posisi keuangan konsolidasian interim tanggal          consolidated statement of financial position as at
31 Maret 2024, serta laporan laba rugi dan           31 March 2024, and the interim consolidated
penghasilan komprehensif lain konsolidasian interim,   statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive
laporan perubahan ekuitas konsolidasian interim dan   income, interim consolidated statement of changes in
laporan arus kas konsolidasian interim untuk periode    equity and interim consolidated statement of cash
tiga bulan yang berakhir pada tanggal tersebut, serta    flows for the three-month period then ended, and
catatan atas laporan keuangan konsolidasian interim,   notes to the interim consolidated financial statements,
termasuk informasi kebijakan akuntansi material.        including material accounting policy information.

Menurut opini kami, laporan keuangan konsolidasian    In our opinion, the accompanying interim consolidated
interim terlampir menyajikan secara wajar, dalam        financial statements present fairly, in all material
semua hal yang material, posisi keuangan              respects, the interim consolidated financial position of
konsolidasian interim Grup tanggal 31Maret 2024,      the Group as at 31 March 2024, and its interim
serta kinerja keuangan konsolidasian interim dan       consolidated financial performance and its interim
arus kas konsolidasian interimnya untuk periode tiga    consolidated cash flows for the three-month period
bulan yang berakhir pada tanggal tersebut, sesuai      then ended, in accordance with Indonesian Financial
dengan Standar Akuntansi Keuangan di Indonesia.     Accounting Standards.

Basis opini                                     Basis for opinion

Kami melaksanakan audit kami berdasarkan Standar  We conducted our audit in accordance with Standards
Audit yang ditetapkan oleh Institut Akuntan Publik      on Auditing established by the Indonesian Institute of
Indonesia. Tanggung jawab kami menurut standar       Certified Public Accountants. Our responsibilities
tersebut diuraikan lebih lanjut dalam paragraf          under those standards are further described in the
“Tanggung jawab auditor terhadap audit atas laporan    “Auditors’ responsibilities for the audit of the interim
keuangan konsolidasian interim” pada laporan kami.    consolidated financial statements” paragraph of our
Kami independen terhadap Grup berdasarkan           report. We are independent of the Group in
ketentuan etika yang relevan dalam audit kami atas    accordance with the ethical requirements that are
laporan keuangan konsolidasian interim di Indonesia,   relevant to our audit of the interim consolidated
dan kami telah memenuhi tanggung jawab etika         financial statements in Indonesia, and we have fulfilled
lainnya berdasarkan ketentuan tersebut. Kami yakin    our other ethical responsibilities in accordance with
bahwa bukti audit yang telah kami peroleh adalah      these requirements. We believe that the audit
cukup dan tepat untuk menyediakan suatu basis bagi   evidence we have obtained is sufficient and
opini audit kami.                                       appropriate to provide a basis for our opinion.

Hal audit utama                             Key audit matters

Hal audit utama adalah hal-hal yang, menurut        Key audit matters are those matters that, in our
pertimbangan profesional kami, merupakan hal yang    professional judgement, were of most significance in
paling signifikan dalam audit kami atas laporan         our audit of the interim consolidated financial
keuangan konsolidasian interim periode kini. Hal-hal    statements of the current period. These matters were
tersebut disampaikan dalam konteks audit kami atas   addressed in the context of our audit of the interim
laporan keuangan konsolidasian interim secara         consolidated financial statements as a whole, and in
keseluruhan, dan dalam merumuskan opini kami atas   forming our opinion thereon, and we do not provide a
laporan keuangan konsolidasian interim terkait, kami    separate opinion on these matters.
tidak menyatakan suatu opini terpisah atas hal audit
utama tersebut.

   mengestimasi nilai wajar aset derivatif tersebut         estimating the fair value of the derivative asset
   pada tanggal 31 Maret 2024.                       as at 31 March 2024.

   Kami mengidentifikasi penilaian atas aset derivatif    We identified the valuation of the derivative asset
   yang timbul dari hak tambahan partisipasi dalam        arising from the additional participating right in
   investasi di KNI sebagai hal audit utama karena        investment in KNI as a key audit matter given the
    signifikansi jumlah aset derivatif tersebut terhadap      significance of the amount of the derivative asset to
   laporan keuangan konsolidasian interim, serta          the interim consolidated financial statements, as
   pertimbangan, asumsi-asumsi signifikan, dan            well as the significant judgements, assumptions
   kompleksitas model yang digunakan Grup dalam      and complexity of the model used by the Group in
   mengestimasi nilai wajar aset derivatif.                 estimating the fair value of the derivative asset.

   Bagaimana audit kami merespons Hal Audit        How our audit addressed the Key Audit Matter
   Utama

   Prosedur audit kami meliputi sebagai berikut:         Our audit procedures included the following:

   •   Kami memperoleh pemahaman dan               •  We understood and evaluated the Group’s
       mengevaluasi pengendalian internal Grup                internal controls relating to the process of
         terkait dengan proses mengestimasi nilai               estimating the fair value of the derivative asset;
       wajar aset derivatif;

   •   Kami memperoleh pemahaman mengenai          •  We understood the relevant terms of the
       ketentuan yang relevan terkait dengan hak              additional participating right in the investment
      tambahan partisipasi dalam investasi di KNI              in KNI by evaluating the supporting documents
      dengan mengevaluasi dokumen-dokumen            such as DCA, Joint Venture Agreement and
      pendukung seperti DCA, Joint Venture               Share Subscription Agreement;
      Agreement dan Share Subscription
       Agreement;

   •   Kami menilai kompetensi, kapabilitas dan          •  We assessed the competence, capabilities and
        objektivitas pakar eksternal Grup, serta                   objectivity of the Group’s external expert and
       mengevaluasi pekerjaannya, dalam                   evaluated their work in estimating the fair value
       mengestimasi nilai wajar aset derivatif;                   of the derivative asset;

   •   Dengan bantuan pakar internal kami, kami         •   With the assistance of our internal expert, we
        menilai asumsi-asumsi signifikan yang               assessed the significant assumptions that
       digunakan manajemen dalam estimasinya           management used in its estimates regarding
         terkait dengan nilai wajar aset derivatif,                 the fair value of the derivative asset, including
       termasuk tingkat volatilitas dan tingkat                 the volatility rate and discount rate, by
        diskonto, dengan membandingkan asumsi-           benchmarking to comparable market data;
       asumsi tersebut dengan data pasar yang
       sebanding;

   Utama

       mengevaluasi pengendalian internal Grup               relevant internal controls relating to the
      yang relevan terkait dengan proses                   process of determining the provision for asset
